tm.「ベロベローン。\n みんな 大変そうだベローン。\n チカラになってあげたい: "Beloberoon. Everyone seems to be having a hard time, beloberoon. I want to help, beloberoon.
tm.「ベロベローン。\n のどかで いい村だベローン。\n ずっと 住みたくなるんだ: "Beloberoon. It's a peaceful, nice village, beloberoon. I'd like to live here forever, beloberoon.

tm.「……んっ なんで いやそうなカオするベロン。\n ベロベロできないなんて 悲し: "...Huh, why the grossed-out face, beloon? Not being able to lick you is sad, beloon.
tm.「ひでえ やられようだな……。\n オレたちのチカラを 必要としている理由が\n: "What a mess they made... I finally understand why you needed our strength.
tm.「ここが あんたの故郷か。\n これからは オレたちが この村を守る。\n あん: "So this is your hometown. From now on, we'll protect this village. You can travel in peace.
tm.「幼なじみが ヨメさんかぁ……いいなぁ。\n あんたのことは さんざん うらやん: "Your childhood friend is your wife, huh... Nice. I envied you plenty, but now I'm more jealous than ever!
tm.「グロッタの武闘会で 戦ったときから\n ただ者じゃないと 思っていたが\n ま: "Since fighting you at the Octagonia tourney, I knew you were no ordinary guy, but you saved the world...
tm.「今や ロトゼタシアの英雄だもんな。\n お前に負けたときは くやしかったが\n: "Now you're the hero of Erdrea. I was bitter when I lost to you, but now I'm honored to have fought you.
tm.「今の お前の実力からすると\n オレたちなんか 相手にならないと思うが\n ま: "With your strength now, we wouldn't be any match, but if you want to fight again, just say so.
